newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander to propose nominal share cut.
newsitem.headline: Santander to propose nominal share cut.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander is to propose a three-for-one nominal share split, with the face value falling to 250 pesetas from 750 pesetas, a statement from the bank said on Monday.
The move will need shareholder approval.
Santander said the move was aimed at easing small investors' access to the shares.
This will multiply the number of shares in circulation by three to 479 million, without varying the bank's capital, which is 119.8 billion pesetas.
Consolidated shareholders' equity was 1.5 trillion pesetas at the end of 1996.
